release_question: Can the platform record two-sided faculty-student intent, manage opportunity term lifecycle, and preserve consent-controlled completed outcomes?

subscriptions_and_notifications.delivery: In-product notification list; open Notifications after signing in as verified faculty.

fixture_loading.r1_r2_fixtures: Existing R1/R2 fixture files and intake/subscription data continue to load using the existing startup process.
fixture_loading.acceptance_criteria: data/expected_lifecycle_results.json (read by verify_r3_fixture.py only; not imported as product records)
fixture_loading.method: Idempotent startup import after additive R3 schema migration. Faculty/student fixture IDs map to synthetic @algomau.ca users; opportunity records map to projects; matches, match_students, outcomes, outcome_students and outcome_consents are populated.
fixture_loading.clock: The app reads evaluation_date from lifecycle_fixture.json (2026-11-06) via r3_effective_date(); expiry compares deadlines against this simulated date, not the machine date.
fixture_loading.verification: Run python verify_r3_fixture.py from repository root after app startup.

notes: Partner contact name/email and engagement state/leader are returned only to verified faculty.
Industry opportunities are hidden from student/guest discovery until at least one verified faculty member records willingness.
Notifications are in-product; subscriptions never gate browsing.
The demo sign-in is a course prototype, not production identity verification.

matching.note: Confirmed means intent to work together only; not course registration, eligibility, credit or university approval.

lifecycle.discovery: GET /api/projects excludes Expired, Withdrawn, Matched and Archived opportunities.

partner_agreement.note: Faculty-recorded statement of agreement in principle; does not imply partner used the platform.

outcomes.note: Public display requires faculty confirmation, public faculty profile, and consent from all listed participants. Partner contact details are excluded.
